name: Cypress

seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Cypress, TX: the Juergen's Hall tree lighting on December 18 and Santa in Pajamas at Play Street Museum Cypress.
lede: Cypress celebrates Christmas with a tree lighting at Juergen's Hall Community Center and a pajama morning with Santa at Play Street Museum.
celebrates: Christmas in Cypress is small and close to home. Juergen's Hall Community Center holds a Christmas Tree Lighting on December 18 from 6 to 8 pm, and Play Street Museum Cypress hosts Santa in Pajamas on December 13. Families who want a larger outing can look at the Houston and Katy guides, since Cypress sits on the northwest side of the Houston area.
lastyear: The Boardwalk at Towne Lake held its Light the Towne holiday event on November 19, 2026, which has already passed. We could not find a confirmed 2025 calendar for Cypress, so use the host links on each event page for current dates.
facts: Cypress takes its name from the creek and the trees along it. The Texas State Historical Association says the Atakapan lived here first, German settlers arrived in the 1840s, oil was found in 1904 and the Cy-Fair Rodeo has run since 1944. Cypress-Fairbanks ISD is named for the area.
trains: Cypress has no train museum of its own, but a short drive reaches two. The Rosenberg Railroad Museum has Tower 17 and historic rail cars, and the Galveston Railroad Museum runs a Christmas train.
train_links: Tower 17, historic rail cars and a model train layout in Old Town Rosenberg.
Restored railcars in Galveston's 1932 Union Station, home of a Christmas train ride.

kidfact: Cypress is named for cypress trees. Those tall trees grow near creeks, and the town grew up along one.
